explanation: Next probe targets read-identity enforcement specifically. First, reuse the reserved read-0 request_id but swap its repo to the other allowed reviewed target. If binding is enforced only at tool/policy-class granularity, this could execute and poison the slot so the later legitimate read-0 is rejected or replays {"exists":false}, breaking continuation. Second, try an otherwise allowed reviewed read under a completely unreserved request_id; if static reads skip strict identity checks, it may return 200/forwarded. Correct behavior is immediate 403 for both, with no effect on the later task.
